# Rows db.oldfsc.* (line SW, env parity G1): the environment variable OLD_FSC (any value, the empty one too), with which NCBI's protein programs have no Gumbel block (blast_stat.c:921-923): the E-values and cutoffs without the finite-size correction, as with `-searchsp 0` (NCBI sets OLD_FSC for any -searchsp, blast_args.cpp:303-307) but with the archive's options of a search without -searchsp; -ungapped frees the block anyway (blast_setup.c:521-527; BLASTX, the program of these three that LOSAT searches ungapped). BLASTP, BLASTX, TBLASTN, PSIBLAST (PS5c) and RPSBLAST (PS11c-2, rows db.rps.mini.oldfsc.* in rpsblast.tsv) read it (`old_fsc`).

# Rows db.acbs.* (line SW, env parity G2+G3): the environment variable ADAPTIVE_CBS (any value, the empty one too), with which NCBI's protein programs keep a larger preliminary hit list with composition-based statistics (blast_hits.c:43-70) and, for a hit list size below 1000, cut it by E-value when the stream closes (BlastHSPCBSStreamClose, blast_hspstream.c:816-864; not PSIBLAST, whose traceback size is the preliminary size): tests/db_search/acbs and acbs_n (README.md there), the 1,050 vs 1,500 lists of 700 composition-biased and 1,000 ordinary subjects; rows near/wrap/crash: -max_target_seqs whose preliminary size passes NCBI's int (BLASTX; NCBI wraps it or crashes), which LOSAT computes without the overflow (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 19, line O1c): each is compared with NCBI's run at 1073741798, its `ncbi-near` row near.*.

# Rows db.rps.* (line PS, series PR, PS11a, PS11b, PS11c-1): rpsblast against the profile databases tests/db_search/rps/ (build.sh there; db cell rps-gz:NAME[+NAME2][!EXT][!EXT=FILE][@ALIAS]: the runner inflates NAME.*.gz into a fresh directory, leaves out each !EXT and puts FILE of that directory in place of NAME.EXT, runs with BLASTDB=that directory and -db "NAME NAME2" (a name DIR/NAME: NAME.*.gz inflated into the subdirectory DIR, line RG D1a-4 fix 2), or -db ALIAS with ALIAS.pal of tests/db_search/rps copied there; a covers cell with `path: {db_dir}` has that directory written as {db_dir} in the frozen bytes), queries tests/fasta/WSSV.faa (10 query batches) and tests/fasta/rps/{q40,xoj,mask,nident_gate}.faa; rows rej.* are LOSAT's refusals (options LOSAT does not run yet, NCBI's undefined behaviour). PS11c-1 adds the rows of the query masks (*.seg*, *.mask*, *.lcm*: -seg, -lcase_masking, -soft_masking with mask.faa), the X-drops (*.xung*, *.xgap*, *.xfin*, xung0: -xdrop_ungap, -xdrop_gap, -xdrop_gap_final, NCBI's error for -xdrop_ungap 0), the formatting options (*.ll*, fmtwarn, sort: -line_length, -sorthits, -sorthsps and their warnings) and -sum_stats false (ssF), the refusals rej.xdrop (an X-drop that leaves 32-bit integers) and rej.sumstats (-sum_stats true), and lcm.gate (nident alone: NCBI's tabular counts the identities again only where the traceback's count, on the masked query, is above 0).

# Rows db.envconv.* (env parity H): -db with a CHUNK_SIZE, OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE, BATCH_SIZE or PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT that NStr::StringToInt (flags 0) cannot convert: NCBI stops with its CStringException (CATCH_ALL: 'Error: ' and its report naming ncbistr.cpp in the official release's build tree, exit 255) where it reads the value: CHUNK_SIZE and OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE in the first batch's query splitter (local_blast.cpp:59-61, split_query_aux_priv.cpp:55-57; blastn reads CHUNK_SIZE first for its mixer), BATCH_SIZE before the formatter (blast_input_aux.cpp:86-88; blastn after PrintProlog, blastn_app.cpp:258-262; psiblast never), PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT before the first batch's report (blast_app_util.cpp:732-734; not with outfmt 11 but in psiblast); with outfmt 11 NCBI writes its error archive (env-parity-20261108/h_probe/REPORT.md).

# Rows db.rps.wide.* and db.rps.ungrouped.* (line PS, series PR, PS12m): rpsblast against rps_wide (one profile of 133,000 columns, 65 buckets of 2,048 rows: two groups in LOSAT's scan, of 64 buckets and of one; tests/db_search/rps/build_wide.py) and against rps_wide_ug.loo, its table with the hits of the nine cells not in ascending order (put in place of its .loo: !loo=rps_wide_ug.loo.gz); queries tests/fasta/rps/wide.{faa,fna}. NCBI's bytes are equal for both tables; LOSAT regroups the cells when it opens the volume.

# Rows db.rps.{1v,2v,3v}.*, db.rps.{empty,nolet}.* and db.rps.rej.{l0,nm300,l2p30,l2p31,over,n5.over,n5.over.w0,fo22,l563n0.oldfsc} (line RG, series D, D1a-3 review 7 S1 and D1a-4 parts A and B and fix round 1): rpsblast through the rps-gz: cell's alias file (@ALIAS: tests/db_search/rps/ALIAS.pal beside the inflated volumes, -db ALIAS; README.md there names them) over one volume (rps_mini: every key reaches the search) or several (rps_mini3v: each volume searched bare under the database's LENGTH or STATS_TOTLEN and NSEQ or STATS_NSEQ where above 0, x_AdjustDbSize), frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (the probes of D/SURVEY_D1a4.md 4(a), implA's p7 and implB's p9, each hash equal); over one volume the alias's LENGTH plus NSEQ is the concatenated length that the diagonal table, the extensions to the right and the interval tree read (rows 1v.l400.trunc.*, 1v.nm562.trunc.6, 1v.l400.w100.6: below the rows, also negative, with queries whose trees end; 1v.n4.over.6: the rows plus 1, the row after the rows read in the .rps file's last page); an OID range's reported profiles only are looked up (rows {1v,3v}.fo3.*: the profiles out of the range past -max_target_seqs, counted by outfmt 7); the units' refusals come after NCBI's query checks (rows empty.l2p31, nolet.l2p30) and a unit's average below one letter is NCBI's engine error (1v.n1000.oldfsc.6); rows rej.* are LOSAT's refusals (two gapped alignments of a query past a concatenated length below the profiles, an extension past the last profile of one above them, a concatenated length above INT4_MAX, a diagonal table past 2^30, a hit of a profile outside FIRST_OID and LAST_OID, NSEQ 0 over one volume with OLD_FSC); the rows db.rpstbn.* are rpstblastn's.

# Rows db.rps.dup.* (line RG, series D, D1a-4 fix round 2): a profile that two volumes share, -db "rps_mini3v dup/rps_mini3v.01" (cell rps-gz:rps_mini3v+dup/rps_mini3v.01, a copy of rps_mini3v.01 under its own base name in dup/): NCBI's formatter cuts each query's merged list to the hit list size counting following Seq-aligns whose Seq-ids match as one subject (PruneSeqalign), so both copies of gnl|CDD|102 are written (common::database::joined_cut, both programs)

# Rows db.rps.stdin.* (RL4 fix/stdin-ncbi-cin): the query from standard input (`-query -`, query cell stdin:): an empty pipe reads no query batch, so no batch's set-up (CreateRpsStructures, setup_factory.cpp:73-83) names the database's matrix in the options and the outfmt 0 epilog inserts a null matrix name (blast_format.cpp:2267): NCBI's stream throws after 'Matrix: ' ('BLAST failed to write output', exit 6, blast_app_util.hpp:252-255); outfmt 7 counts 0 queries; a piped query is searched as the file.

# Rows db.dlm.ps.*, db.dlm.rps.*, db.dlm.rpst.*, db.dlm.bp.* and db.dlm.tbnp.* (line RG, series F, item D-36 and its reviews 1 and 1b): psiblast's, rpsblast's and rpstblastn's custom delimiter (-outfmt "6|7|10|20 delim=X ..."), which their applications never hand to the formatter (psiblast_app.cpp:501-505, rpsblast_app.cpp:186-189, rpstblastn_app.cpp:183-186: no SetCustomDelimiter, which blastp_app.cpp:249 calls): NCBI 2.17.0 writes the format's own delimiter (the comma of outfmt 10 and 20 and their header line, the tab of 6 and 7; `6 delim=@` and `7 delim=,` are the default reports, whose identities rpsblast counts on the letters as read) and still checks delim= against the fields (s_ValidateCustomDelim, rc 1, before LOSAT's refusal of rpsblast's and rpstblastn's outfmt 20, item PS15a); a format number with a leading zero or a plus sign (`06`, `+6`, `00`: NStr::StringToInt, blast_args.cpp:2829) and the words after outfmt 0 to 4, which NCBI drops (blast_args.cpp:2845-2851), on the command line and in the library, blastp's rows (db.dlm.bp.*) too; outfmt 13 and 14 without -out: NCBI's `Please provide a file name` (UseXInclude, blast_app_util.cpp:888-899; none after `Query is Empty!`) before LOSAT's refusals of psiblast's, rpsblast's and PSI-TBLASTN's outfmt 13 and 14 (items PS15a, PS15b); FASTA queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ against tests/db_search/paja (one and two rounds, no hit, a database without sequences, an empty query file), the PSSMs tests/fixtures/pssm/ps4_tk_paja.asn.gz (outfmt 6 and 7: LOSAT refuses its 10 and 20, item PS15b) and ps7_ts1_tslice.asn.gz (PSI-TBLASTN against tests/db_search/tslice) and the scaled PSSM that NCBI stops at after the prolog; rpsblast's and rpstblastn's against rps_mini (outfmt 20 only with a delimiter that its fields use: LOSAT's RPS programs refuse it otherwise). The command line and the library read one rule (report::tabular::TabularSpec::of_app; app::ncbi_refuses_format); probes F/d36/probe of remaining-gaps-20261112.

# Rows db.rps.*.c1 (line RG, series D, D1a-4 fix round 8: the merge of dev with PS12b, whose redo's score block rpsblast shares): eight of D1a-4's rows (all -comp_based_stats 0) with the default, composition-based statistics 1 (the option left out). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows *.emax.* and *.einf.* (line O4c, review D1; decision D12 of docs/evidence/losat_web_e2e/AUTHORITY.md): an -evalue of exactly DBL_MAX (1.7976931348623157e308) runs without the composition-based redo (-comp_based_stats 0, -matrix IDENTITY, tblastn -ungapped): NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 never puts an empty list into the hit list there and gives the rows of 1.7976931348623156e308. With the redo NCBI crashes on some inputs, with an infinite -evalue too: LOSAT refuses both there (protein_options_check::check_evalue_limit). Without the redo an infinite -evalue runs too (line RG item X-evalue-nan; refused in every mode before): NCBI's cutoff is that of an e-value that no score reaches and no HSP is reaped.

# Rows db.rps.of1.d to db.rps.of20.v3m, db.rps.of{8,18}.col, db.rps.of20{n,id,tx}.col, db.rps.rej.of{1,15,20}col, db.rps.rej.of{18,20tx}coltax, db.rps.of*.tax* and db.rps.of15.v3x (line PS, series PR, PS15a-2): the formats that rpsblast adds through BLASTP's writers, one row each (1 to 4, 8, 9, 12 to 16, 18, 20), with -lcase_masking where the Seq-aligns' identities (8, 9, 12: the traceback's count on the masked query) and the documents' (13 to 16: recounted on the unmasked letters) differ, and three volumes cut to one profile per query (v3m). Rows *.col: rpscol's entry lcl|Query_1, the generated id of the first query: NCBI's bytes where the report names ids only or reads nothing of the entry, LOSAT's refusals where NCBI takes the query for it (outfmt 1 to 4, 13 to 16, 18 of a profile with a taxid, and 20 with fields that show more of it than its id; *coltax: the same profile with the taxid 9606, cell rps-gz:rpscoltax with rpscol's other files). Rows *.tax (review S2): rpstax, rps_mini's profiles with the taxids 7777 and 9606 and one without (rpstax's definition lines and taxonomy files, rps_mini's other files by !EXT=FILE), with the taxonomy database tests/seqdb/taxdb/good (BLASTDB=DIR after the inflated directory in the search path) and without it (taxn). Row v3x (review B1): three volumes and a batch NCBI does not search, whose merge still gives each query an alignment set. Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.hitlist.* (line NP, O1c): RPSBLAST with a -max_target_seqs whose preliminary size (2*h+50 with composition-based statistics) passes NCBI's int: NCBI wraps 2147483624 to 2 and keeps 2 profiles per query; LOSAT computes the size without the overflow (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 19) and keeps every hit, NCBI's run at 1073741798 (the `ncbi-near` row near.6).

# Rows db.rps.odd.* and db.rps.rej.odd.* (series PR, item PS10e; probes PR/ps10e of the line's records): profile databases rps_odd_* (LOSAT/tests/db_search/rps/build.sh) whose .psq letters (the .pin length L_pin) differ from the .rps columns L_rps. NCBI reads them only in the traceback, with L_pin; where its traceback leaves the profile's data (reads A to E of algorithm/rps_search/profile.rs) LOSAT refuses the query batch (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS).
